question: Which state in India has the highest literacy rate according to the provided data in the Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Census 2011**, **Mizoram** has the highest literacy rate among the given options, standing at **91.33%**. It is the second-highest state in **India** in terms of literacy, following **Kerala**.
 
• **Rajasthan** has a literacy rate of **66.11%**, which is significantly lower than the national average and the rate of Mizoram. *Hence, option 2 is incorrect.*
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** recorded a literacy rate of **65.38%** during the **2011** census operations, placing it among the states with lower educational reach. *Hence, option 3 is incorrect.*
 
• **Bihar** has the lowest literacy rate in **India** at **61.80%**, reflecting a major gap in educational infrastructure at that time. *Hence, option 4 is incorrect.*
 
• The **Census 2011** data is the most authentic source for these figures, as the **2021 Census** was delayed. <stron
